description: Source code for managing manufacturing operations, including classes for stock moves, workcenter lines, production, and operations with methods for scheduling, state transitions, and operation control in an ERP system.

classes.name: stock_move
classes.description: Extends stock.move with additional move destination lines and custom copy method.

classes.name: mrp_production_workcenter_line
classes.description: Represents a workcenter line in manufacturing, with methods for date calculations, state transitions, and scheduling.

classes.name: mrp_production
classes.description: Extends manufacturing order with planning, scheduling, and state management functionalities.

classes.name: mrp_operations_operation_code
classes.description: Defines operation codes with start/stop statuses for manufacturing steps.

classes.name: mrp_operations_operation
classes.description: Represents manufacturing operations linked to production, with methods for delay calculation, validation, and workflow control.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Overrides copy to reset move destination lines.

methods.name: _get_date_date
methods.description: Calculates start date in date format.

methods.name: _get_date_end
methods.description: Calculates end date based on planned date and timesheet intervals.

methods.name: modify_production_order_state
methods.description: Changes production order state based on action (start, done, cancel, etc.).

methods.name: write
methods.description: Overrides write to update start date based on planned date.

methods.name: action_draft
methods.description: Sets workcenter line to draft state.

methods.name: action_start_working
methods.description: Starts work on a workcenter line, updating state and start time.

methods.name: action_done
methods.description: Marks workcenter line as done, calculates delay.

methods.name: action_cancel
methods.description: Cancels workcenter line.

methods.name: action_pause
methods.description: Pauses workcenter line.

methods.name: action_resume
methods.description: Resumes workcenter line.

methods.name: _production_date_end
methods.description: Calculates production end date based on workcenter lines.

methods.name: action_production_end
methods.description: Ends production, marking all workcenter lines as done.

methods.name: action_in_production
methods.description: Sets production to in production state.

methods.name: action_cancel
methods.description: Cancels production and associated workcenter lines.

methods.name: _compute_planned_workcenter
methods.description: Recomputes planned dates for workcenter lines based on sequence.

methods.name: _move_pass
methods.description: Adjusts start dates for passed production orders.

methods.name: _move_futur
methods.description: Adjusts start dates for future production orders.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Overrides write to handle scheduling and date adjustments.

methods.name: action_compute
methods.description: Recomputes planning after calculation.

methods.name: _get_order_date
methods.description: Retrieves order date for an operation.

methods.name: calc_delay
methods.description: Calculates delay based on operation start/stop codes.

methods.name: check_operation
methods.description: Validates operation state transitions based on codes.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new operation, updating workflow and scheduling.
